display.purpose: Poppins 800, -0.025em, word-spacing 0.06em. Page h1s and figures. Ramp: 56/80/112 at lh 0.95 (home hero, mobile/sm/lg, two lines), 48/64/88 (page heroes), 48/72 (form, demo, privacy and section heroes), 44/80 (closers), 60/72 (price figures; 60/72/88 for the Website Fix on Services). The pricing h1 at 40/60/80 is drift, not a step.

headline.purpose: Poppins 700, -0.02em. Section and tile headlines. Ramp: 40/56, 40/64, 36/48, 32/36 (offer cards, demo title), 32/36/44 (price groups), 32 (price columns, Steps numerals).

subhead.purpose: Inter 500. One-line follow-up under a headline. Ramp: 19/24 (default, including the home hero), 19/21, 17/21.

title.purpose: Sentence-case 600 lines: Privacy section titles (21/24), FAQ summaries (19/21), card, price-table and demo-panel titles (19), Steps, price-column and payment-term names (17).

body.purpose: Lead paragraphs 17/21, tile copy 17/19, lists 16, offer details, price notes and Steps copy 15; dense UI (price tables, the demo) 14-15 with 12-13 meta; measure 420–640px.

label.purpose: Inter. Field labels 14/600; meta and the demo banner 14; tags, badges, table headers and the nav CTA 13/600; footer 12; demo status tags 12/600; nav links 14/500.

shadows.name: floating-panel
shadows.purpose: White mock panel floating on a dark tile.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Neutral ink focus ring on fields; deliberately not red.

shadows.name: hero-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-red) 40%, transparent), transparent); filter: blur(40px)
shadows.purpose: Red-only glow under the bottom edge of black hero tiles (.tile-glow); now the pricing hero only, not the red home hero.

shadows.name: hero-radial
shadows.value: radial-gradient(90% 70% at 50% 0%, var(--color-red) 0%, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(120% 100% at 50% 100%, var(--color-red-deep) 0%, var(--color-red) 75%)
shadows.purpose: Home hero ground (.tile-hero). Every stop is red or darker so white text stays >= 5.88:1.

shadows.name: nav-hairline
shadows.purpose: Only separation under the solid red nav; nothing is translucent.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Flat separation instead of a shadow: the demo card and its rows, Steps cards, unselected demo tabs, time slots, the Not available yet badge and small notes on snow.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: @keyframes rise-in { from { transform: translateY(40px) } to { transform: none } }; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 0% entry 40%
motion.purpose: Transform-only scroll reveal; no opacity, no scale; only with animation-timeline support and no reduced-motion preference.

contrast.note: Large text only: the pricing h1's second line, at display size (40px and up).
Minimum for text on red grounds (hero, nav links, the final Steps card).
Hero bottom edge and mobile menu panel.
Available badge, selected demo tab, the /demo fictional banner.

contrast.pair: white on hero link pill (white/10 over red)
white on hero link pill hover (white/20 over red)
contrast.note: Lowest text pair on the site; the fill must not get lighter.
Non-text; always followed by its sentence.

full.use: Full-colour mark + CapitalSites wordmark (Ottawa line removed), transparent; light grounds; footer at 96px tall.

markWhite.use: Solid white symbol for red/dark grounds; nav at 32px tall beside the Poppins 700 19px wordmark.

icons.use: The full-colour symbol: icon.png transparent (512px), apple-icon.png on white (180px), favicon.ico 16 and 32px.

logo.peaceTower: The symbol's tower resembles Parliament's Peace Tower; the owner's earlier brief said no government-style imagery. The owner supplied the logo, asked for it to be used and approved keeping the tower on 2026-11-26. It is an exception for the brand mark, not a precedent for new imagery.

demoStatus.scope: /demo only (src/components/demo/MapleDemo.tsx). Classes .status-ok, .status-warn, .status-bad and .status-dot-green/-amber/-red in src/app/globals.css. Not palette tokens and not accents.

pairs.name: status-ok
pairs.use: Won requests, delivered alerts, confirmed visits, accepted quotes, successful results.

pairs.name: status-warn
pairs.use: New requests, waiting alerts, sent quotes, anything that needs attention.

pairs.name: status-bad
pairs.use: Failures, overdue replies, emergencies, lost requests, declined or expired quotes, blocked actions. A different red from Maple Red.

demoStatus.rule: Always paired with a word; never an accent, a decoration or a ground outside /demo.

focus.name: pill
focus.purpose: Pills; the outline turns white inside .on-dark.

focus.name: field
focus.value: border-color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 14%, transparent)
focus.purpose: Fields and selects; never red. The contact form's transparent service select draws it on the visible field beneath.

focus.name: nav
focus.purpose: Links and the menu button on the red nav; the Contact pill keeps its pill radius at a 2px offset.

layout.containerDemo: 1180px (the /demo console and its simulated-vs-real panel; every other page uses the 1024px container)
layout.stepsRise: Top offsets 96 / 64 / 32 / 0px from md on a shared bottom, so each Steps card rises 32px
layout.priceTableColumns: table-layout: fixed; one shared colgroup of 32% / 28% / 18% / 22% so every group's table lines up; stacked rows below md
layout.twoWaysSubgrid: Home pair: md:grid-rows-[repeat(6,auto)] with each card md:row-span-6 md:grid-rows-subgrid, so all six rows line up across both cards
layout.phoneStatusStrip: Maple demo phone screenshots carry a plain 47pt nav-red strip above the page so the Dynamic Island covers nothing

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Product Page"**

CapitalSites is a small Canadian web studio that sets up digital operations and websites for contractors and home-service businesses, and the site presents that work the way Apple presents a phone: the product, a working system, is shown big, running on real screens, and priced plainly. Every section is a full-bleed tile. The brand opens in red: a solid red nav bar sits over a red hero, then true black, white and Apple grey alternate as the ground, with near-black ink tiles as punctuation. Headlines are set in Poppins (800 for display, 700 for headlines), the geometric face that matches the owner's logo wordmark, large enough to carry a section alone. Inter carries body and UI text. The supporting copy is one short line and one chevron link.

The product imagery is the studio's own work, set inside CSS-drawn MacBook and iPhone frames (`public/shots/*.jpg`): the fictional Maple Home Services demo on the home hero and in the demo teaser, and the three concept sites in the "Websites, too." band and on Services and Portfolio. There is no stock photography, no icon-card grid and no testimonial carousel. Depth comes from the devices, not from card chrome. Motion is a single transform-only scroll-driven rise, written in CSS, which disappears when reduced motion is requested.

This world replaces the earlier receipt world, which the owner rejected as plain. The three concept demos under `src/app/portfolio/{fade-and-co,ember-kitchen,maison-noir}` are separate worlds with their own styling and are out of scope here. The legacy `--color-red-brand` (#8B1A1A) token exists only for their banners and is not part of this system. The `/demo` console is not a separate world: it is built from this system's tiles, panels, pills and fields, and adds only a set of status colours scoped to that page (see Colors).

The owner's logo is the brand mark: a full-colour symbol with a "CapitalSites" wordmark (`public/logo-full.png`), a colour symbol alone (`public/logo-mark.png`) and a solid white symbol for red or dark grounds (`public/logo-mark-white.png`). All have transparent backgrounds. **Peace Tower note:** the symbol includes a tower that resembles Parliament's Peace Tower, while the owner's earlier brief said no government-style imagery in the logo or header. The owner supplied this logo, asked for it to be used and approved keeping the tower on 2026-11-26, so it ships as is. It is an exception for the brand mark, not a precedent for new imagery.
keyCharacteristics: A red opening: solid red nav bar over a red radial hero, both with white type.
Full-bleed alternating tiles below: black, snow and white, with an ink tile for punctuation.
One accent only: deep maple red. No secondary hue; the demo's status colours stay inside `/demo`.
Poppins display (800, -0.025em) and headline (700, -0.02em) type with balanced wrapping; Inter for everything else.
Pill buttons (980px radius) and ink chevron text links ("Learn more ›") that turn red on hover.
Real screenshots inside CSS MacBook and iPhone frames: the Maple demo for operations, the concept sites for websites.
Centred composition on a 1024px container. Tiles in a mosaic sit 12px apart on white.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Red is the only accent. As a full ground it is allowed in two places only, the first things a visitor sees: the nav bar and the home hero (owner request: the first screen should pop). Below that first screen the standard rule applies. Otherwise it goes on primary buttons, links on hover and key highlights (checkmarks, the pilot badge, the final Steps card). Every other surface is a neutral. Red text is for large type or for white grounds (and snow, 5.40:1). Gradients are not used for text. The home hero's radial is the one red gradient, and every stop in it is red or darker.

rules.name: The Red On Black Is Large Only Rule
rules.body: Red on black is 3.57:1, which passes only for large text. It appears once, on the pricing h1's second line ("Agreed in writing first."), at display size (40px and up, Poppins 800). Body-size links and copy on dark grounds stay white. Text on red grounds (the hero, the nav, the final Steps card, the pilot badge) is white or white at 90% (4.95:1), never lower.

rules.name: The Status Stays In The Demo Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and the status red exist only inside `/demo`, always paired with a word, and never as an accent, a decoration or a ground anywhere else. Maple Red never marks a problem, there or anywhere.

rules.name: The Stay On The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Headline sizes come in pairs from the list above (40/56, 36/48, 32/36, 48/64/88, 56/80/112). Do not add one-off steps.

rules.name: The Poppins For Display Only Rule
rules.body: Poppins is for `.display`, `.headline` and the wordmark. Body, subheads, labels, buttons and nav links stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Title Not Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Small lines above headlines are sentence-case titles in Inter 600 at 21px or larger. The site has no uppercase, letter-spaced kickers.

rules.name: The Product Casts The Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows go on devices and on cards that float over a contrasting ground. Tiles, offer and price cards, Steps and the demo card stay flat. Separation comes from colour change, the 12px white gap or a 1px hairline ring.

dos: Do open with the red nav and red hero, then build sections as full-bleed tiles alternating black and snow or white, with an ink tile as punctuation.
Do take every display and headline size from the ramp (e.g. 56/80/112, 48/64/88, 40/56, 36/48) in Poppins via `.display` (800) or `.headline` (700).
Do use the white logo symbol on red or dark grounds and the full-colour logo on light grounds.

Do show the product as real screenshots in the MacBook or iPhone frames, cropped by the tile edge: the Maple demo for operations, the concept sites for websites. New phone screenshots of this site get the 47pt nav-red strip on top so the Dynamic Island covers nothing.
Do end a section with one pill pair or one to two chevron links. Chevrons are ink on light (red on hover) and white on black and ink tiles.

Do keep keyboard focus visible: a 3px ink outline on pills and demo tabs (white on dark), a 2px currentColor outline on chevron links, a 2px white outline on the red nav, and an ink border and ring on fields.
Do keep text on red grounds (the hero, the nav, the final Steps card) at white or white/90 (4.95:1) and text on light grounds no lighter than ink-2.
Do keep the `.rise` reveal CSS-only, transform-only (no opacity fade), and gated by `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do show an offer's availability with its badge beside the name (offer cards, price tables, the contact form), and give offers that are not available yet a ghost pill, not a filled one.
Do keep the compact controls (`.pill-sm`, `.field-sm`, `.field-compact`, `.demo-quiet`) to dense UI such as the demo; marketing sections keep the 44px pill and the 52px field.
Do pair every demo status colour with a word ("Confirmed", "Overdue", "Green: everything is working"), and keep the sticky ink "Fictional demonstration" banner on `/demo`.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, and don't put gradients on text. The home hero radial is the only red gradient, and it never uses a stop lighter than red.
Don't use red as a full ground beyond the nav bar and the home hero. Sections below the first screen are black, ink, snow or white, with red only on buttons, link hover and key highlights.
Don't set body, buttons or nav links in Poppins. It is the display face only.
Don't set body-size red text on black (3.57:1). Red on black is for large display text only.
Don't use red for field focus or other neutral states. Maple Red must never read as an error; inside the demo, problems use the separate status red, always with a word.
Don't use the demo status colours, or any green or amber, outside `/demo`, and never as a ground, a decoration or a brand accent.

Don't use the Canadian flag, a maple leaf, a "Canada" wordmark or government-style imagery, and don't imply any government affiliation. (Exception approved by the owner on 2026-11-26: the logo's tower resembles the Peace Tower and stays as part of the brand mark.)
Don't add stock photography, icon-card grids or testimonial carousels. The devices and the type carry the page.
Don't put uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows above headlines. Use a sentence-case 21px+ title line or nothing.
Don't put shadows on tiles, offer or price cards, Steps or the demo card. Shadows belong to devices and to floating cards.
Don't use `red-brand` (#8B1A1A) or any concept-demo styling on the main site. Those belong to the portfolio demo worlds.
Don't revert to the receipt / thermal-paper world (cream paper, monospace, Oswald). The owner rejected it.
